clock: perf_counter; per-row times relative to trial start
phase_policy: Scheduling phase determines membership. Schedule continuously for 90 seconds, including the final second, with no warmup drain. At 90 seconds stop arrivals and drain remaining work for at most 12 seconds. Record actual drain time in the active budget; do not omit slow work. Refuse another trial if its 90 seconds plus bounded drain and fault reserve cannot fit the remaining budget.
optional_public_trial: not executed; no separate qualified HTTPS fixture
optimization: at most one justified correction, two additional 90-second larger/four-RPS trials only
